_about: Photo catalogue for section image slots: what each gallery photo shows, whether it is a before/after pair, and which frame ratios it survives. Pairs must be captioned "Before and after". Written by viewing every file; update it whenever the gallery changes.

eyeliner/01.subject: Winged eyeliner on a closed eye, close-up with the face tilted; cotton swab at the top edge, cheek and side of the nose below
eyeliner/01.caption: Fresh
eyeliner/01.notes: Taken in the chair: jet-black, crisp line with a cotton swab in frame. The eye sits in the top third, so wide crops need the top-biased focus.

eyeliner/02.subject: Two stacked close-ups of one client with eyes open: top, one eye with a thin winged liner; bottom, the other eye with matching liner; brows are done in both. Both panels show finished work; there is no before
eyeliner/02.caption: Two views
eyeliner/02.notes: Two panels meeting 49% down with no divider line, but both are after shots (one per side), so it is catalogued as a collage and must not be captioned "Before and after". A ~5px black strip runs along the bottom edge.

eyeliner/03.subject: Close-up of one open eye looking up, hazel iris, thin black upper liner ending in a small wing; soft brow across the top right
eyeliner/03.caption: Close-up
eyeliner/03.notes: At 5 / 2 the eye fills the frame height and the brow drops out; keep the given focus.

lash-enhancement/01.subject: Lash line enhancement before (top) and after (bottom): the same open eye, grey-blue iris; after adds a dark line along the upper lashes with a short flick at the outer corner
lash-enhancement/01.caption: Before and after
lash-enhancement/01.notes: Thin white divider. A dark filled brow shows at the top left of both panels.

lip-tint/01.subject: Lip tint before (top) and after (bottom): closed lips, face-on; pale, low-contrast lips before, even rosy-pink colour after
lip-tint/01.caption: Before and after
lip-tint/01.notes: Thin white divider. 4 / 5 trims the corners of the mouth slightly.

lip-tint/02.subject: Lip tint before (top) and after (bottom): pale, dry-looking closed lips before; glossy coral-red lips after, slightly parted with teeth showing
lip-tint/02.caption: Before and after
lip-tint/02.notes: Thin white divider. Light-grey scroll-bar remnant at the right edge of the top panel (the 1 / 1 and 4 / 5 crops leave it out). 4 / 5 trims the corners of the mouth.

lip-tint/03.subject: Lip tint before (top) and after (bottom): pale pink closed lips before; deeper rosy-red closed lips with a defined outline after
lip-tint/03.caption: Before and after
lip-tint/03.notes: Thin white divider. The mouth spans nearly the full width, so 4 / 5 cuts off its corners.

lip-tint/04.subject: Lip tint before (top) and after (bottom): pale mauve closed lips before; soft rosy-pink closed lips after
lip-tint/04.caption: Before and after
lip-tint/04.notes: Thin white divider. The mouth already runs edge to edge, so every crop loses its corners (4 / 5 most). Faint scroll-bar remnant at the right edge of the bottom panel (the 1 / 1 and 4 / 5 crops leave it out).

microblading-shading/01.subject: One full brow with fine strokes at the front and shading through the tail, above a closed eye with full dark lashes; client lying down, second brow and eye at left, nose at bottom left
microblading-shading/01.caption: Close-up
microblading-shading/01.notes: The brow tail ends near the right edge: a centred square crop clips it, so use the 1 / 1 focus given. 5 / 2 fits both brows with little margin and leaves the lower eye out.

microblading-shading/02.subject: One full dark brow with fine strokes at the front and shading through the tail, glossy balm on the brow head, above a closed eye with full lashes; client lying on white bedding, nose at left, second brow and eye at top
microblading-shading/02.caption: Fresh
microblading-shading/02.notes: Byte-identical to ombre-powder-brows/02; never use both on one page. At 3 / 2 both brows only just fit (keep the 28% focus); 5 / 2 cuts the lower brow.

microblading-shading/03.subject: Smiling client lying down with eyes closed and head turned: soft brow with fine strokes at the front, nose rings, ear studs, lips and teeth
microblading-shading/03.caption: Close-up
microblading-shading/03.notes: Widest framing in the set (most of the face and the neck) and the smallest file (944x1024). 5 / 2 keeps the brows and closed eyes and drops the mouth.

microblading-shading/04.subject: Three stacked strips of the same client, face-on: top, brows filled in with a soft powdery look, eyes lowered; middle, bare sparse brows, eyes lowered; bottom, finished brows with hair strokes and shading, eyes open
microblading-shading/04.caption: Before and after
microblading-shading/04.notes: Three panels with white dividers 33% and 67% down; each strip is about 3:1. The top two panels are befores (with and without fill), the bottom one the after.

microblading-shading/05.subject: Client lying on white bedding with eyes closed and head turned: soft brows with fine strokes at the front and shading through the tail; nose and nude-pink lips at left
microblading-shading/05.caption: Close-up
microblading-shading/05.notes: 5 / 2 keeps the lower brow, eye, nose and lips; the upper brow drops out.

microblading-shading/06.subject: Face rotated about 90 degrees, client lying down: a dark brow with fine strokes at the front runs vertically beside an open brown eye, glossy balm at the brow head; second brow and eye at top, nose at top right
microblading-shading/06.caption: Fresh
microblading-shading/06.notes: Small dark-grey semicircle (a screenshot UI remnant) on the bottom edge near the right corner; the 1 / 1 focus given keeps it out. 3 / 2 shows the main brow and eye only; 5 / 2 cuts the brow.

microblading-shading/07.subject: Tight close-up of one dark shaded brow arching over an open brown eye; the other eye blurred at bottom right
microblading-shading/07.caption: Close-up
microblading-shading/07.notes: Very tight crop. The brow tail starts at the left edge, so 4 / 5 is anchored left; 5 / 2 cuts the brow. A pale band of skin follows the brow's upper edge.

microblading-shading/08.subject: Two stacked close-ups of one client with eyes open and eyeliner: top, one brow with strokes at the front and shading through the tail; bottom, the other brow. Both panels show finished work; there is no before
microblading-shading/08.caption: Two views
microblading-shading/08.notes: Two panels split by a white line 50% down, but both are after shots (one per side), so it is catalogued as a collage and must not be captioned "Before and after".

microblading/01.subject: One full brow of fine hair strokes curving across the frame below a closed eye, face upside down (shot from above the head); nose at top right, second brow and eye partly visible at bottom right
microblading/01.caption: Close-up
microblading/01.notes: The face is inverted in the frame. At 5 / 2 the closed eye is cut at the top edge; the brow stays whole.

microblading/02.subject: Microblading before (top) and after (bottom): the same brow with the eye closed, face tilted; sparse, fine natural hairs before, a fuller, darker brow of hair strokes after
microblading/02.caption: Before and after
microblading/02.notes: No divider line; the halves meet at a hard edge where the lighting changes.

microblading/03.subject: Microblading before (top) and after (bottom): sparse brow under a brow-mapping ruler with tick marks, then a full, dark brow of hair strokes with the eye below
microblading/03.caption: Before and after
microblading/03.notes: Two panels of unequal height (white divider 37% down). Catalogued as a collage because the before panel carries a measuring ruler; it is still a before/after, so caption it "Before and after".

microblading/04.subject: Microblading before (top) and after (bottom): both brows and open eyes, face tilted; thin, sparse brows before, fuller brows of hair strokes after
microblading/04.caption: Before and after
microblading/04.notes: No divider line; the halves meet at a hard edge. Dark hair fills the left edge, so 4 / 5 is anchored right.

microblading/05.subject: One brow of fine hair strokes running diagonally beside a closed eye, client lying down with head turned; second eye and brow at top right
microblading/05.caption: Close-up
microblading/05.notes: The brow spans about 60% of the height, so 5 / 2 cuts it. Patchy redness and a blemish on the forehead at left.

microblading/06.subject: Both brows of dark hair strokes on a face rotated about 90 degrees (client lying down): one brow at top left, the other at bottom right, closed eyes with heavy dark lashes, nose bridge between
microblading/06.caption: Close-up
microblading/06.notes: The two brows sit on a corner-to-corner diagonal; any landscape crop slices one of them.

microblading/07.subject: Microblading before (left) and after (right): the same brow, close-up; sparse, light natural hairs before, dense crisp hair strokes after
microblading/07.caption: Before and after
microblading/07.notes: No divider line; the halves meet at a hard edge. The brows run almost the full height of each half, so 3 / 2 cuts their ends: square only.

microblading/08.subject: Microblading in three panels: two after shots of the brows with open hazel eyes (top, full width; bottom left) and one before (bottom right) showing a sparse brow with a brow-mapping ruler and drawn guide lines
microblading/08.caption: Before and after
microblading/08.notes: White dividers 49% down and, in the bottom row, 50% across. Measuring ruler and mapping lines in the before panel.

ombre-powder-brows/01.subject: Client lying on a white pillow looking up with eyes open, head turned: dark powder brows with a softer front; nose and lips at left
ombre-powder-brows/01.caption: Close-up
ombre-powder-brows/01.notes: Small dark-grey semicircle (a screenshot UI remnant) on the bottom edge near the right corner: the 4 / 5 crop shows it, the 1 / 1 and 3 / 2 focus values keep it out. 3 / 2 and 5 / 2 show the lower brow only; at 5 / 2 it spans almost the full frame height.

ombre-powder-brows/02.subject: One full dark brow with fine strokes at the front and shading through the tail, glossy balm on the brow head, above a closed eye with full lashes; client lying on white bedding, nose at left, second brow and eye at top
ombre-powder-brows/02.caption: Fresh
ombre-powder-brows/02.notes: Byte-identical to microblading-shading/02 (the same photo filed under both services); never use both on one page. The front of the brow shows fine hair-like strokes, so it reads more like a combination brow than a pure powder brow. At 3 / 2 both brows only just fit (keep the 28% focus); 5 / 2 cuts the lower brow.

ombre-powder-brows/03.subject: Two stacked close-ups of one client lying down with eyes closed: top, one powder brow with the nose at left; bottom, the other powder brow with hair at left. Both panels show finished work; there is no before
ombre-powder-brows/03.caption: Two views
ombre-powder-brows/03.notes: Two panels split by a white line 49% down, but both are after shots (one per side), so it is catalogued as a collage and must not be captioned "Before and after".

ombre-powder-brows/04.subject: Client lying down with eyes closed and head turned: dark powder brows with a soft front; ear with a stud at left, nose and top of the lips at bottom
ombre-powder-brows/04.caption: Close-up
ombre-powder-brows/04.notes: The second brow's tail sits near the right edge, so 4 / 5 is anchored right.

ombre-powder-brows/05.subject: Two stacked close-ups of one client lying on white bedding with eyes closed: top, one powder brow with the nose and lips below; bottom, the other powder brow with the nose and lips at right. Both panels show finished work; there is no before
ombre-powder-brows/05.caption: Two views
ombre-powder-brows/05.notes: Two panels split by a white line 50% down, but both are after shots (one per side), so it is catalogued as a collage and must not be captioned "Before and after".

pomi/portrait.subject: Waist-up portrait of a woman with long black hair, black blazer over a white V-neck top, facing the camera against a plain grey backdrop
pomi/portrait.caption: Portrait

scalp-micropigmentation/01.subject: Scalp micropigmentation before (left) and after (right): back of the head with short brown hair; scalp shows through a thin crown before, the crown reads denser after
scalp-micropigmentation/01.caption: Before and after
scalp-micropigmentation/01.notes: No divider line; the halves meet at a hard edge. Grey wall and door behind, red top at the shoulders.

scalp-micropigmentation/02.subject: Scalp micropigmentation before (left) and after (right): top of the head from above, brown hair; pale scalp shows along a thinning part before, the scalp is shaded darker after
scalp-micropigmentation/02.caption: Before and after
